TF: same frozen requested-ratio consumer, all-one maturity, original AABB
evaluation: 161 fixed non-Bank archived evaluation views; 69 Bank views only determine Raw SI
ranking_ties: descending score, source row ascending; B frozen predecessor-preserving global merge
diagnostic_geometry: geometry-only scalar radius; within frozen Fixed-h8 cells for every arm, redundancy=max off-diagonal selected kappa, singleton=0; same metric/partition for every arm

dense_regions.dense: top ceil(10% occupied fixed-h8 cells), occupancy desc then key asc
dense_regions.important: minimal prefix of fixed-h8 cells covering >=80% Raw SI, mass desc then key asc
dense_regions.root_views: also report same rules over Sparse roots, defined before quality

primary_gate.A: at least 3/4 ratios have C-Raw PSNR >= -0.02 dB
primary_gate.B: low-ratio mean C-Raw PSNR >0.10 OR (one >0.20 and other >=-0.02)
primary_gate.C: no systematic tradeoff; substantive PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS direction mix downgrades GO to INCONCLUSIVE

metric_interpretation_fixed_before_rende.systematic_tradeoff: at least 2 ratios jointly have SSIM<-0.002 and LPIPS>0.005 while PSNR increases
metric_interpretation_fixed_before_rende.mixed_downgrade: substantive SSIM or LPIPS worsening in a low ratio with positive PSNR, or in at least two ratios with positive PSNR
metric_interpretation_fixed_before_rende.photo: reported fully; not separately tuned or used to replace PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS gate

strong_gate.paired_low: both low ratios PSNR positive-view fraction >=0.60 and median delta >0
strong_gate.redundancy: both low ratios mean geometry redundancy reduced >=10% and >0.9 pairs decrease
strong_gate.near_fixed: mean(C-B PSNR)>=-0.05 OR both low C-B>=-0.10 with no systematic other-metric worsening

case_rules.D: low mean<-0.02 OR (mean all<-0.02 and >=3 ratios<-0.02); mixed cases explicitly INCONCLUSIVE
case_rules.E: D-C low quality satisfies same +0.10 mean or +0.20/-0.02 gain test with no metric tradeoff
case_rules.F: all ratios abs(C-E PSNR)<=0.02, abs SSIM<=0.002, abs LPIPS<=0.005
